services.desc: For anglers who love variety and action, our Ground Fishing Charter is a full-day trip targeting bottom-dwelling species like Haddock, Pollock, Cod, and more. Fishing depths can range from 100-300 feet, and every drop brings the chance of a hard-hitting catch and a cooler full of delicious fillets. This trip is all about steady action and quality table fare.
